# パッケージ読み込み

```{r}
library(rethinking)
library(dagitty)
```

# 5.1

```{r}
data(WaffleDivorce)
d <- WaffleDivorce

# 変数を標準化
d$A <- scale(d$MedianAgeMarriage)
d$D <- scale(d$Divorce)

sd(d$MedianAgeMarriage)
```

```{r m5.1}
m5.1 <- quap(
  alist(  
    D ~ dnorm(mu, sigma),
    mu <- a + bA * A,
    a ~ dnorm(0, 0.2),
    bA ~ dnorm(0, 0.5),
    sigma ~ dexp(1)
    ),
  data = d
)
```

```{r}
set.seed(10)
prior <- extract.prior(m5.1)
mu <- link(m5.1, post=prior, data=list(A=c(-2, 2)))
plot(NULL, xlim=c(-2, 2), ylim=c(-2, 2))
for (i in 1:50){
  lines(c(-2, 2), mu[i, ], col=col.alpha("black", 0.4))
}
```

```{r}
A_seq <- seq(from = -3, to = 3.2, length.out=30)
mu <- link(m5.1, data=list(A=A_seq))

mu.mean <- apply(mu, 2, mean)
mu.PI <- apply(mu, 2, PI)

plot(D ~ A, data = d, col=rangi2)
lines(A_seq, mu.mean, lwd=2)
shade(mu.PI, A_seq)

precis(m5.1)
```

```{r m5.2}
d$M <- scale(d$Marriage)

m5.2 <- quap(
  alist(
    D ~ dnorm(mu, sigma),
    mu <- a + bM * M,
    a ~ dnorm(0, 0.2),
    bM ~ dnorm(0, 0.5),
    sigma ~ dexp(1)
  ),
  data = d
)

M_seq <- seq(from = -3, to = 3.2, length.out=30)
mu <- link(m5.2, data=list(M=M_seq))

mu.mean <- apply(mu, 2, mean)
mu.PI <- apply(mu, 2, PI)

plot(D ~ M, data = d, col=rangi2)
lines(M_seq, mu.mean, lwd=2)
shade(mu.PI, M_seq)

precis(m5.2)
```

```{r 5.7}
dag5.1 <- dagitty(
  "dag{
    A -> D
    A -> M
    M -> D
  }
  "
)

coordinates(dag5.1) <- list(x = c(A=0, D=1, M=2), y = c(A=0, D=1, M=0))
drawdag(dag5.1)
```

```{r}
cor(d$M, d$A)
cor(d$M, d$D)
cor(d$D, d$A)
```

```{r 5.8}
DMA_dag2 <- dagitty('dag{D <- A -> M}')
impliedConditionalIndependencies(DMA_dag2)
```

```{r 5.9}
DMA_dag1 <- dagitty('dag{D <- A -> M -> D}')

impliedConditionalIndependencies(DMA_dag1)
```

```{r 5.12}
set.seed(10)

N <- 50
age <- rnorm(N)
mar <- rnorm(N, -age)
div <- rnorm(N, age)

lm(div ~ age)
lm(div ~ mar)


lm(div ~ age + mar)
```

```{r 5.15}
mu <- link(m5.3)

mu_mean <- apply(mu, 2, mean)
mu_PI <- apply(mu, 2, PI)

D_sim <- sim(m5.3, n=1e4)
D_PI <- apply(D_sim, 2, PI)
```

```{r 5.16}
plot(mu_mean ~ d$D, col=rangi2, ylim=range(mu_PI),
     xlab = "Observed divorce", ylab = "Predicted divorce"
     )
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2)
for (i in 1:nrow(d)){
  lines(rep(d$D[i], 2), mu_PI[, i], col=rangi2)
}

identify(x=d$D, y=mu_mean, labels=d$Loc)
```


```{r 5.18}
N <- 100
x_real <- rnorm(N)
x_spur <- rnorm(N, x_real)
y <- rnorm(N, x_real)
d <- data.frame(y, x_real, x_spur)

pairs(d)

lm(d$y ~ d$x_real + d$x_spur)
```

```{r 5.19}
data(WaffleDivorce)
d <- WaffleDivorce
d$A <- standardize(d$MedianAgeMarriage)
d$M <- standardize(d$Marriage)
d$D <- standardize(d$Divorce)

m5.3_A <- quap(
  alist(
    ## A -> D <- M
    D ~ dnorm(mu, sigma),
    mu <- a + bM * M + bA * A,
    a ~ dnorm(0, 0.2),
    bM ~ dnorm(0, 0.5),
    bA ~ dnorm(0, 0.5),
    sigma ~ dexp(1),
    
    ## A -> M
    M ~ dnorm(mu_M, sigma_M),
    mu_M <- a_M + bAM * A,
    a_M ~ dnorm(0, 0.2),
    bAM ~ dnorm(0, 0.5),
    sigma_M ~ dexp(1)
  ),
  data = d
)

precis(m5.3_A)
```

```{r 5.20}
A_seq <- seq(from = -2, to = 2, length.out = 30)
```

```{r 5.21}
sim_dat <- data.frame(A=A_seq)

s <- sim(m5.3_A, data=sim_dat, vars=c("M", "D"))
```

```{r 5.22}
plot(sim_dat$A, colMeans(s$D), ylim=c(-2, 2), type="l",
     xlab="manipulated A", ylab="counterfactual D")
shade(apply(s$D, 2, PI), sim_dat$A)
mtext("Total counterfactual effect of A on D")


plot(sim_dat$A, colMeans(s$M), ylim=c(-2, 2), type="l",
     xlab="manipulated A", ylab="counterfactual M")
shade(apply(s$M, 2, PI), sim_dat$A)
mtext("Total counterfactual effect of A on M")
```

```{r 5.23}
sim_dat <- data.frame(M=seq(from=-2, to=2, length.out=30), A=0)
s <- sim(m5.3_A, data=sim_dat, vars="D")

plot(sim_dat$M, colMeans(s), ylim=c(-2, 2), type="l",
     xlab="manipulated M", ylab="counterfactual D")
shade(apply(s, 2, PI), sim_dat$M)
mtext("Total counterfactual effect of M on D")

```

```{r 5.24}
A_seq <- seq(from=-2, to=2, length.out=30)

post <- extract.samples(m5.3_A)
M_sim <- with(post, sapply(1:30,
                           function(i) rnorm(1e3, a_M + bAM*A_seq[i], sigma_M)))

D_sim <- with(post, sapply(1:30,
                           function(i) rnorm(1e3, a + bA * A_seq[i] + bM * M_sim[, i], sigma)))
```

```{r 5.29}

m5.5_draft <- quap(
  alist(
    K ~ dnorm(mu, sigma),
    mu <- a + bN * N,
    a ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    bN ~ dnorm(0, 1),
    sigma ~ dexp(1)
  ), data = d
)
```

```{r 5.31}

dcc
```

```{r}
n
```

```{r}
n <- 100
M <- rnorm(n)
N <- M + rnorm(n)
K <- N - M + rnorm(n)

d_sim <- data.frame(K=K, N=N, M=M)


lm(K ~ N, data=d_sim)
lm(K ~ M, data=d_sim)
lm(K ~ N + M, data=d_sim)
```

```{r}
dag5.7 <- dagitty("dag{
    M -> K <- N
    M -> N
}")

coordinates(dag5.7) <- list(
    x=c(M=0,K=1,N=2),
    y=c(M=0.5,K=1,N=0.5)
)

MElist <- equivalentDAGs(dag5.7)

drawdag(MElist)
```
